title: 1 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 1 Corinthians 3: milk instead of meat, planting and watering, the one foundation, and the temple of God.

questions.text: What did the writer say he had fed the Corinthians with?
questions.explanation: He says he fed them with milk, not with meat, because they were not yet ready.

questions.text: What were some of them saying, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 quotes them saying "I follow Paul" and "I follow Apollos".

questions.text: Who gave the increase, after one planted and another watered?
questions.explanation: Paul planted and Apollos watered, but God gave the increase.

questions.text: According to verse 8, what will each man receive his own reward according to?
questions.explanation: The text says each one will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

questions.text: What two images does verse 9 use for the readers?
questions.explanation: The verse calls them God's farming and God's building, and says we are God's fellow workers.

questions.text: What is the foundation that has been laid, which no one can replace?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says no one can lay any other foundation than the one laid, which is Jesus Christ.

questions.text: According to verse 13, what will test what sort of work each man's work is?
questions.explanation: The verse says the work is revealed in fire, and the fire itself will test what sort of work it is.

questions.text: What does verse 16 say the readers are?
questions.explanation: It asks whether they do not know that they are a temple of God, and that God's Spirit lives in them.

answers.text: A city set on a hill
A field that has been left unplanted
A temple of God in whom God's Spirit lives
A letter written by the apostles

questions.text: According to verse 19, what is the wisdom of this world with God?
questions.explanation: The verse says the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God.

questions.text: How does the chapter describe the readers and Christ at the end?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says that you are Christ's, and Christ is God's.

answers.text: They are Paul's, and Paul is Christ's
They are Apollos', and Apollos is God's
They are the world's, and the world is Christ's
They are Christ's, and Christ is God's
